sentences.text: Vs. The State of W. B. & Anr.
Mr. Anwar Hossain, Ms. Debjani Sahu, .....for the State.
Learned advocate appearing on behalf of the State submitted a report.
Let the report be kept with the record.
It appears from the report that after completion of trial the case was disposed of and the FIR named persons were acquitted from the case on December 23, 2022.

The instant revisional application has been filed by the petitioner for quashing the proceeding of G.R. Case No. 10877 of 2012 arising out of Regent Park P.S. Case no. 200 of 2012 dated 13.9.2012 under Section 498A/406/120B/34 of the IPC read with Section 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.text: Regent Park P.S. Case no. 200 of 2012
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Considering the report, it appears that the entire criminal proceeding was disposed of by the learned competent Court.
Thus, the pendecy of the revisional application become infructuous.
Accordingly, the instant criminal revisional application is dismissed as influctuous.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
